finalists.label: Appendicitis
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence for it, including ultrasound assessment compatible with plastron appendicitis.

finalists.label: Intestinal obstruction
finalists.why: It explains the abdominal pain, voluntary guarding, and air-fluid levels on plain abdominal X-rays.

finalists.label: Cecal Infarction
finalists.why: It accounts for the computed tomography findings of a linear lesion and edema on the anterolateral aspect of the cecum.

frontier_selector.why: The ultrasound assessment interpreted as compatible with plastron appendicitis specifically supports Appendicitis over other finalists.
